title: C¹ maps on an open set: Lipschitz on compacta, null images, rectifiable images
statement: Let m, d, P ∈ ℕ, let D ⊆ ℝ^d be open and let G : ℝ^d → ℝ^P be C¹ on D. Write H^m := μHE[m]. Then (i) for every compact K ⊆ D there is L ≥ 0 such that G is L-Lipschitz on K; (ii) H^m(G(S)) = 0 for every S ⊆ D with H^m(S) = 0; (iii) G(S) is countably m-rectifiable for every countably m-rectifiable S ⊆ D (Simon Ch. 3, 1.1: S ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_k Ψ_k(ℝ^m) with H^m(M₀) = 0 and every Ψ_k : ℝ^m → ℝ^d Lipschitz).
lean_statement: ∀ (m d P : ℕ) (D : Set (Euclid d)) (G : Euclid d → Euclid P), IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G D → (∀ K : Set (Euclid d), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzOnWith L G K) ∧ (∀ S : Set (Euclid d), S ⊆ D → μHE[m] S = 0 → μHE[m] (G '' S) = 0) ∧ ∀ S : Set (Euclid d), S ⊆ D → CountablyRectifiable m S → CountablyRectifiable m (G '' S)
